# Observation lies within the downstream: a difference goes only downstream

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`observation-is-a-route` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](observation-is-a-route.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A stock's difference goes only downstream; for every law reading into each condition, courses apart only in the stock are alike off its downstream, so the stock couples into a formation only through a level it reads downstream (coupling by level: the route of length zero); routes form by closing.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A difference goes only downstream: where the starting gap is positive at one stock alone and the part gives no gap, a gap conveyed to a condition at a step lies downstream of the stock by the couplings formed by that step; so the carried amount, the most difference that can arrive, is zero wherever not downstream. Chains join, and a route formed stays formed. (`Becoming.Upstream.single`, `Becoming.Upstream.trans`, `Becoming.Upstream.snoc`, `Becoming.Upstream.before_mono`, `Becoming.conveyed_upstream`, `Becoming.carried_zero_off_downstream`)
2. A route forms by closing: the routes formed by step T + 1 are those formed by T and those through a coupling acting at step T. (`Becoming.upstream_succ_iff`, `Becoming.route_forms_by_closing`)
3. Reading into each condition: what a formation exchanges with a condition is fixed by the levels the schedule marks for that condition. A law reading a schedule is the case reading alike for every condition, and so is a law reading through a coupling; a level unread into a condition is coupled into it with strength zero, so the strengths restricted to what is read are strengths of the law, and their routes are routes of reading. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsInto`, `Becoming.readCouplings`, `Becoming.restrictInto`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsAt.readsInto`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.readsInto`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsInto.respondsWithin_unread`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsInto.restrict`, `Becoming.couplesAt_readCouplings`, `Becoming.upstream_readCouplings`)
4. What a difference reaches lies within the downstream: for every law reading into each condition a schedule of listed levels, two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in a stock, are alike at each step at every condition not downstream of the stock by the readings formed by then; so a formation whose readings into a condition all lie off the downstream exchanges alike, and so does one, under a law reading through the couplings, all of whose couplings lie off it. The stock coupled in by level is the route of length zero. (`Becoming.apart_only_downstream`, `Becoming.exchange_alike_off_downstream`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.alike_off_downstream`)
5. The measurement witness: from step T a formation adds the stock's level to a record, and draws from the stock while the record shows at least N. Before T only the stock lies downstream of it and no loop passes through it; at T the route stock → record and the loop stock → record → draw form; in two courses apart only on the stock the record is alike up to T and differs by the raise across the step from T, and the draw responds to the record. (`Becoming.Observation.Measure.law`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.reads`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.readsInto`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.listed`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.no_coupling_from_stock`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.downstream_before`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.no_loop_before`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.route_at`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.record_into_stock`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.loop_at`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.couples_after`, `Becoming.Observation.Measure.draw_responds`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each theorem needs is written into it: the schedule a law reads into each condition (ReadsInto), the levels read being listed; the starting gap at the stock alone and none from the part (for the carried amount); two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in the stock (for the courses). No decision on conditions, and no finiteness of conditions, is used.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That what lies downstream differs: a formation may read without responding; the witness gives one case where it does.
- Which schedule a law reads, when a measurement starts and whether the record is read in time; measurement with error.
- Statements on courses by strengths: bounding a difference of histories apart in many places by strengths changes them one place at a time and needs a decision on conditions; the theorems on courses here use the schedule read.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

P124 left open how a formation comes to observe a stock it depends on; Ren answered P124's approach with “approve your approach, please continue”. This result answers in part: a formation can observe only at the end of a route of readings from what is observed; the converse, that what lies downstream makes a difference, fails. That necessity is a noninterference property (Goguen and Meseguer 1982): what is not downstream of the stock is unaffected by it, as in the dependency-graph reading of information flow. Readings (the AI's, weakened to what apart_only_downstream shows and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D43): observing lies within the downstream: a formation's exchange responds to a difference at a stock only through a level it reads that lies downstream of the stock, direct observation being the route of length zero and a measurement, a model or another's reading a longer route; a formation comes to observe by a reading that closes a route; the reading of the stock's level before the break in P124's second reading is such a route. That observation is not a second relation beside dependence, in the sense that obs could be derived from dependence, goes beyond the theorem, which shows only that observation does not go beyond dependence, not that it is dependence; it is kept as a conjecture, not a reading. Since OB1 it is settled at the step of the exchange (what-dependence-alone-carries-of-a-level). In the sense that obs and dependence are both coupling, by level and by threshold, it holds (where-a-level-couples, adopted by its place in one account, DELEGATED-CHOICES D45).
